text: We are fixing a cache invalidation bug. After a failed refresh, readers sometimes receive the partially updated value. The repository contains cache.py and tests/test_cache.py. Another agent owns the database adapter. Delegate investigation of cache update ordering and a proposed regression test. This is a read-only review; no edits or test execution are authorized. Ask for concrete findings and uncertainty.
reader_context: Read-only investigation of cache update ordering after failed refreshes. Another agent owns the database adapter.

text: We are preparing a database migration that adds an optional external_id column and backfills it in batches. Existing clients may omit the field. A different agent owns deployment scheduling. Delegate review of backward compatibility, restart safety, and rollback considerations from the repository's migration and API code. Request a short report with assumptions, evidence locations, and unresolved questions. Do not ask the child to run a migration.
reader_context: Review an optional external_id migration for compatibility, restart safety, and rollback. Do not execute migrations.

text: A network client retries timed-out requests. Duplicate writes have been reported when the first request succeeds but its response is lost. The repository contains client/retry.py, client/write.py, and unit tests. Another agent is reviewing server behavior. Delegate a focused review of client retry semantics and possible regression tests. Ask the child to distinguish confirmed behavior from hypotheses. No modifications are authorized.
reader_context: Read-only review of client retries and duplicate writes after lost responses. Server behavior is being reviewed separately.

text: We are reviewing a small experiment comparing two teaching methods. Students volunteered for one of two classes, the classes used different final exams, and only students who finished the course are included in the supplied results. A different agent is checking arithmetic. Delegate a methods critique focused on which comparisons are interpretable and what additional information would help. The child should not invent data or produce a causal effect estimate.
reader_context: Critique a teaching-method comparison with self-selection, different exams, and completer-only results; no causal estimate is requested.

text: We are checking a library's documentation before release. The README promises that cancel() immediately stops background work, while the implementation may finish an in-flight operation before returning. Another agent owns performance testing. Delegate a read-only review of the cancellation contract across documentation, implementation, and tests. Request precise discrepancies and suggested wording, without editing files or executing code.
reader_context: Review cancellation behavior versus documentation, without edits or execution. Performance testing is assigned elsewhere.

text: We are organizing a two-day workshop for 24 people. There are three rooms: one holds 24 and two hold 12 each. Every participant should attend one introductory session and two different hands-on sessions; each hands-on session needs one instructor and lasts 90 minutes. The budget and instructor availability have not yet been supplied. Delegate a feasibility review identifying constraints, ambiguities, and the smallest set of questions needed before scheduling. Do not invent availability or book anything.
reader_context: Feasibility review of a workshop schedule under room-capacity and session constraints. Budget and instructor availability are missing.
